spans.s:
अव्रण a. Without wounds or
scars or rents, unhurt, sound.
--णं
One of the four diseases of the eye.

अव्रत a. Not observing (the
prescribed) religious rites or
obligations; अव्रतानाममंत्राणां
जातिमात्रोपजीविनामासहस्रशः समेतानां परिषत्त्वं न विद्यते ॥

अव्रत्यं [व्रताय हितं, यत् न. त.]
Violation of religious duties,
offenceagainst the rule of an ascetic.

आव्रश्च् {c6c} P. To tear off, cut off,
tear in pieces, interrupt.

1 Cutting or tearing
off.
--2 The stump of a tree
(Ved.).

आव्रस्कः Being torn off or tearing
itself off (Ved.).

आव्रीडकः [अव्रीडानां विषयो देशः]
A country of the shameless.
